name: paramander
description: a Paramander, a Khazad dwarf champion (Fall from Heaven), stocky, in bronze-gold plate armour: a rounded bronze helmet with a gold gem on the brow, a big braided brown beard, grey steel pauldrons, a brown tabard with a gold rune, bronze plate legs and boots, a round bronze shield with a gold rune on his RIGHT arm (screen-left), and a big steel warhammer with a gold rune on its block head held in his LEFT hand (screen-right), the hammer head up at the screen-right; at rest his right hand also grips the haft's lower end
hands: the warhammer stays in his left hand on the screen-right side; his right arm on the screen-left side carries the round shield, and at rest that hand also grips the haft's lower end, but during the action it lets go of the haft and keeps the shield

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the warhammer is lifted up over the head with its steel head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the warhammer cocked behind the head with its steel head hanging down behind the shoulders, the round shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the warhammer is level, its steel head pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: hammer arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the warhammer's steel head smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the shield arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the warhammer carries on down until its steel head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the braided beard swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the warhammer lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the round shield flung out to the left, the hammer arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the warhammer dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the hammer arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the warhammer lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the warhammer's steel head resting on the ground, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the warhammer slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the bronze helmet still on his head; the warhammer lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the warhammer and the round shield on the ground beside him
